description: Use this when a draft should change before it sends. Requires auth and message_send or draft_write. A key with only draft_send can set send_at and cannot edit other fields. This call does not send the draft. Inputs: inbox_id (required), draft_id (required), and any of to, cc, bcc, reply_to, subject, text, html, add_attachments, remove_attachments, add_labels, remove_labels, include_signature, send_at. include_signature false skips the inbox signature when the draft is sent. Omit it to leave that choice unchanged. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Null, or an empty list for recipients, clears that field. Scheduling a draft (send_at) counts as sending and needs message_send or draft_send. HTTP 403 permission_denied with param send_at when a non-null send_at lacks that permission, and nothing is changed. send_at null removes the schedule and the scheduled label and is allowed with draft_write. Editing recipients, subject, body, or attachments while send_status is scheduled needs message_send or draft_send. Reply and forward cannot be changed. The scheduled label cannot be set by hand. A draft with send_status sending returns HTTP 409 draft_sending. Returns the updated draft.

add_attachments.description: Attachments to add. Each item is {filename, content_base64, content_type?, content_id?}.

add_labels.description: Labels to add. scheduled is reserved.

bcc.description: Replacement Bcc list. An empty list clears Bcc.

cc.description: Replacement Cc list. An empty list clears Cc.

html.description: Replacement HTML body. Null clears it.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

include_signature.description: Use this when a later send of this draft should skip the inbox signature. true restores the default. Omit to leave it unchanged.

remove_attachments.description: Attachment ids to remove from the draft.

remove_labels.description: Labels to remove. scheduled is reserved.

send_at.description: ISO-8601 time to send, or null to unschedule. Scheduling a draft (send_at) counts as sending and needs message_send or draft_send.

text.description: Replacement plain-text body. Null clears it.

to.description: Replacement To list. An empty list clears recipients. Omit to leave them unchanged.

name: cooper_update_draft
title: Update a draft
